summary: Updated cfitsio package fixes security vulnerabilities
details:
CFITSIO through 4.7.0 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read
vulnerability in the imcompress.c unquantize helpers that allows
attackers to read memory before the fits_rand_value table via a zero or
negative ZDITHER0 seed. Attackers can supply a crafted FITS file with a
SUBTRACTIVE_DITHER_1 compressed image, read through fits_open_file() and
fits_read_pix(), to cause crashes or leak heap contents in decoded
pixels.
